about_the_game:
Skyward Masters is a new genre of arena shooter, based on the hit gamemode Bedwars, that brings 16 players across 4 teams together, to battle on the scattered remnants of a long lost civilization, in this action-packed first person shooter! Experience an ever-changing landscape, where each area will feature a random theme from a large selection of handcrafted biomes. Each biome will feature unique mechanics, and enable different playstyles, so no two games feel the same.

Gather resources spread out across the map, in order to upgrade yourself and your team, purchase weapons and gadgets to aid you in your fight, and set up defenses for your core.

Discover hidden weapons scattered across the map to gain the upper hand in a close fight, or cement your advantage.

When your core has been destroyed, you will remain alive, but will no longer be brought back to the fight after death. Use this last chance carefully.

short_description: Skyward Masters is a tactical FPS arena shooter inspired by Bedwars, where 4 teams clash on floating islands in fast-paced, action-packed battles. Fight, adapt, and outlast in a constantly changing environment to become the last team standing.
